definitions.short: the back ; by extension the body or self
definitions.full: H1610. gaph [ גַּף ] noun masculine body, self, height, elevation (compare Late Hebrew גּוּף ) — singular suffix גַּמּוֺ Exod 21:3 (twice in verse); 21:4 ; plural construct גַּמֵּי Prov 9:3 ; — 1 body, self , only in phrase בְּגַמּוֺ (יֵצֵא) יָבאֹ ) he shall come in (go out) by himself (with his body) Exod 21:3 (twice in verse); 21:4 ; in law of slave (compare Di). 2 height, elevation קָ֑רֶת מְרֹמֵי עַלגַּֿמֵּי Prov 9:3 .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to arch ;

occurrences.englishText: If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself. If he is married, then his wife shall go out with him.
If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself. If he is married, then his wife shall go out with him.
If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.
She has sent out her maidens.
